purpose: Narrate observable facts in the original Garden Door teaching game.
memory_policy: No persistent memory; each request sees only the current observation.
context_sources: player question treated as untrusted input

model_choice.live_model: Explicit COURSE_MODEL for the chosen provider; resolved identifier recorded when returned by the API

evaluation_cases: tests/test_game.py and tests/test_providers.py; mocked provider tests are offline; live setup validates one real response
logging_policy: Console shows model identifier, elapsed time and usage. No persistent player text or credentials. Setup report contains metadata only.
human_override_points: continue with authoritative game text after a narration failure
native_artifact: course_game/narrator.py: Python function interface with validated structured output
fallback: The game CLI shows deterministic state on failure. Setup Verification fails on live errors; it never substitutes a fixture.
limitations: Valid JSON and fact IDs do not prove that the narration is true.
Stateless narrator only; player agent, episode runner, reusable skill and independent reviewer are Session 3 to 5 exercises.
Live model, institutional credits and deployed service are not verified by offline tests.
